verified_behavior: Question-aware reusable answers remain in immutable profile-version snapshots alongside backward-compatible legacy fixture answers.
Changing a question, answer, source, or confidence clears both verification and user approval; the prior profile version remains unchanged.

Answer/contact-only profile revisions retain the exact existing match scores under the new version when matching facts and preferences are unchanged; approved fact or preference edits do not take that shortcut.

The application screen uses the active profile bank through a profile-scoped read endpoint. Normalized exact question matches are suggestions only, show provenance and confidence, and require explicit selection and a separate per-job review.
Profile editor controls remain disabled until the selected saved profile version has loaded, preventing an early answer or fact edit from being overwritten by the asynchronous read.

Unknown questions accept only manually entered, deliberately reviewed text. Sensitive, legal, demographic, criminal-history, salary/compensation, and common work-authorization question variants cannot reuse saved answers; these require application-specific user text.

Reviewed answers create immutable, application-linked TXT document revisions with profile snapshot, question, answer-bank ID, provenance, confidence, and SHA-256. Prior export bytes survive later exports and application reload.

Answer-export metadata and byte downloads are available through profile-scoped application history/download routes; unscoped history omits these records and unscoped byte download returns not-found. Content-addressed output is atomically promoted so a partial/interrupted write cannot occupy the next revision path.
The local export does not fill or submit an employer form. Test mode used synthetic data and local-only browser traffic; external submission remains OFF.

Profile editor sends the version it loaded; API now requires that token on every update to an existing profile and rejects missing or stale tokens with HTTP 409. Store atomically compares the observed version inside the transaction, preventing both delayed stale submissions and overlapping saves from restoring a revoked answer approval.
limitations: Matching supports normalized exact questions only. Fuzzy and semantic variants in MJ-REQ-104 remain unimplemented.
The minimum reusable confidence is currently a fixed 80 rather than a configurable threshold; scoring bands and confidence provenance acceptance in MJ-REQ-105 remain incomplete.

Sensitive-answer detection is a conservative lexical rule set, not the full user-configurable sensitive-answer policy or legally significant profile-policy controls in MJ-REQ-106/107; manual per-application text and deliberate review remain required for detected questions.
Unexported draft questions remain in the browser form; durable history starts when the reviewed TXT export is saved.
Current strict expected-version candidate has local full-suite evidence; fresh exact-head independent review and both-event hosted checks/artifact parsing are pending.
